basics.name: Hi, Alejandro Cabeza
basics.label: Back-end developer with more than 3 years of experience
basics.summary: I am passionate about web development with more than 3 years of experience turning ideas into reality. I master PHP and JavaScript, and I adapt easily to new technologies. Computer Engineering student, eager to keep growing and add value to your company. !!!!!
basics.heroSummary: Backend Engineer with experience in robust and scalable architectures using Node.js (NestJs, Express, AdonisJs), PHP (Symfony, Laravel) and PostgreSQL and MySQL databases. As a Lead Backend Engineer, I have led the development of applications focused on quality and efficiency.
aboutMe: Since I was little, technology was the spark that ignited my imagination and invited me to dream big. Over time, that spark became an inexhaustible flame: I discovered in programming a magic key capable of opening doors to previously unimaginable worlds. Today, I dedicate myself to weaving ideas and transforming challenges into opportunities, fearlessly exploring the limits of innovation. My engine is curiosity and my compass is the constant desire to learn and reinvent tomorrow.

work.name: Wallsteam
work.summary: As a Freelancer Developer, I developed and maintained web projects with WordPress, NextJs, Laravel, Nestjs, Docker, Adonisjs, Express, MySQL and Mongodb, from custom sites to backends and optimization. I collaborated on projects such as Fairpay, Gotitjob, delivering complete, high-performance solutions.

work.name: Athenadexfi
work.summary: Responsible for deploying AthenadeXFi on a VPS (DigitalOcean) and configuring CI/CD for an agile and stable release process.

work.name: Miocondo
work.summary: I led the development and deployment of the backend for a condominium application, optimizing management and communication. I implemented a robust architecture with Laravel, PostgreSQL, Redis and Docker, automating payments and services. I was responsible for the platform’s full deployment and CI/CD implementation, ensuring efficiency, reliability, and high-quality releases.

work.name: Perfexya
work.summary: I led backend improvement and maintenance, resolving critical incidents that reduced response times by 90% and developing features that increased engagement by 70%. I integrated external APIs (e.g., Zoho) with Symfony and MySQL, and implemented Docker to standardize environments and improve team efficiency.

work.name: Deepground
work.summary: As a freelance developer, I created a user management plugin for WordPress in PHP and vanilla JavaScript. This plugin centralized user control, offering a dashboard to visualize records, segment with advanced filters, and manage information, optimizing user base administration.

work.name: SEO
work.summary: I led the construction of the current theme for Empresas Polar (a high-traffic multinational), developed from scratch in TypeScript, Sass, Node.js and PHP. I improved performance and code quality compared to the previous theme, optimized the integration with WordPress, and refined animations with theme-specific dependencies.

projects.name: Brevio
projects.description: I developed the backend and frontend architecture for Brevio, a SaaS application for summarizing documents with AI. I implemented a user account system and background document processing. The main technology is based on Next.js for the frontend and Supabase (PostgreSQL) for the database and authentication, with Prisma as the ORM.

projects.name: Distribuidora Zafiro
projects.description: I built the backend for Zafiro, an ERP system for business management. The platform, developed in PHP with Laravel and Filament, centralizes sales, finance, and inventory. I designed the database in Supabase (PostgreSQL) and the RESTful API to connect the different business areas, optimizing operational efficiency.
